headline: The cruise ship that ran out of money: passengers expelled in Cambodia and ship detained in Singapore
summary: The Villa Vie Odyssey remains under judicial arrest in Singapore after its 203 passengers disembarked in Cambodia. The company attributes the suspension of operations to rising fuel costs.
why: Cruise operators are highly exposed to fuel costs, which are a major operating expense. Legal disputes and vessel detentions can cause sudden losses for operators.
